verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an auth framework, for example bulk-banning users, bulk role changes or mass session revocation. However, the evidence only documents per-item admin operations (creating users, managing roles, banning/unbanning) and a one-off Auth0 migration script. Neither is a documented bulk-operations capability, so the migration script counts only as adjacent support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
